finding: `npm run generate:error-codes -- --check` is named like a read-only validation path but still rewrites generated files and reports `wrote docs\ERROR_CODES.md and packages\core\src\error-code-registry.generated.ts`.
expectedBehavior: A `--check` mode should be non-mutating and fail with a clear stale-projection diagnostic when generated files differ; the mutating path should remain an explicit `--write` or generator command.
evidenceOrRepro: While preparing ATM-GOV-0268 claim admission, the command exited 0 and wrote generated error-code projections despite `--check`, leaving deliverable-like dirty files that blocked the next task claim with `ATM_TASK_SCOPE_EXPANSION_REQUIRED`.
followUp: Split the generator into true check/write modes and add a regression test that asserts `--check` does not modify `docs/ERROR_CODES.md` or `packages/core/src/error-code-registry.generated.ts`.
